mapper.select: SELECT u.username AS name, COUNT(lr.id) AS loginCount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(lr.id) DESC) AS rank FROM login_records lr LEFT JOIN member u ON lr.user_id = u.id WHERE lr.login_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND lr.login_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY lr.user_id ORDER BY rank LIMIT 20
